The '''Alee system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. From [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] to [[26 ABY/Legends|26 ABY]] it was [[Attack on the Alee system|attacked]] by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].
